blocks.x: Now, of course by this time, you know, '38, '39, you were hearing, you had met everyone in
New York, and you were hearing all kinds of things, what was, you know, to you, what was the influence in music so far as bass players?
Well, my influence was already John Kirby and John Hammond and --
Well, what happened when you heard -- (inaudible).
Oh, fantastic. I was on the bandstand with Billy Hicks when Count Basie came into New York.
